newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile to investigate diplomat's death in Haiti.
newsitem.headline: Chile to investigate diplomat's death in Haiti.

text.p: Chile will investigate the death of a Chilean diplomat in Haiti whose body was found in a burnt-out car this week, the Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.
The government will send diplomat Daniel Carbello to Haiti to enquire into the circumstances surrounding the death of first secretary Eduardo Vega, a brief statement said.
A Canadian military patrol from the U.N. peace-keeping mission in Haiti on Tuesday found a charred body in a burnt-out car which was "presumably" Vega, a 58-year-old career diplomat, it said.
The statement gave no further details of the circumstances of Vega's death.
